resources.string: At least 10 characters. There is no password recovery: if you forget it, the account on this device cannot be opened. The server does not store your password.
Import needs the username and password of the exported vault. Export writes the encrypted vault file; it stays protected by the password.
Vault imported. You can unlock it now.
Invalid username. Use 3 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
Could not unlock. Check the username and password.
This username is already taken on the server.
Network error. Check the server address, proxy and connection.
The password must be at least 10 characters.
Invalid server address. Use https://, or http:// only for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and .onion.
An account with this name already exists on this device.
Import failed: not a valid vault or wrong password.
Could not save data to storage.
No user with this exact username on this server.
The server does not confirm this key. It was not accepted.
The contact\'s key changed. Review it before sending.
This file could not be sent.
A group can have at most 100 members.
Some invitations could not be sent. Use Resend invitations in group details.
Invalid proxy. Use an IPv4 address or localhost and a port, for example 127.0.0.1:9050.
No chats yet. Tap + to add a contact by exact username.
Contacts are found only by the exact username. The key the server returns is pinned on first use; compare safety numbers to be sure.
Up to 100 members. Invitations are sent to each member as direct messages.
Any member can read the group key and send messages as a member. The list is not enforced against members who leave.
This deletes the group and its messages from this device. Other members are not notified.
The key of @%1$s changed. Sending is paused.
A message arrived from @%1$s with a different key. This can happen after a reinstall, but could also be an attack. Compare the safety number with the contact over another channel before accepting.
Both of you should see the same number. Compare it by voice or in person.
Applies to new messages in this chat, for everyone in it. Each device deletes a message this long after it arrived there, attachments included. A modified client may keep them.
Messages of this chat will be deleted from this device.
Not yet published on the server. Will retry in the background.
Tor is starting. The first connection can take a minute.
Tor could not connect. Requests fail until it does; nothing is sent outside Tor.
Tor runs inside the app. The default server is reached at its onion address, and every request, including background checks, cover traffic and attachments, goes through Tor.
Tor is off. The default server is reached directly at freeoasis.space, which shows your IP address to it and to Cloudflare.
Without Tor your IP address becomes visible to the server and to Cloudflare, which carries the clearnet connection. Your provider also sees that you connect to Aegis.

Use bridges where Tor is blocked. Snowflake works in most places; if it does not, try obfs4. For WebTunnel or private bridges choose Custom, get lines from bridges.torproject.org or @GetBridgesBot in Telegram and paste them here.
Paste at least one bridge line.
Allow Aegis to install apps, then tap Install update again.
The update check failed. It will be tried again later.
The update did not pass verification and was discarded.

Updates come from the server you use, over Tor when it is on. Before an update is offered the app checks its signature, the file hash, the version and that the package is signed with the same key as the installed app. Checks run while the app is unlocked.
This address is the clearnet entry behind Cloudflare. With Tor on the app uses the onion address of the server.
The default server sits behind Cloudflare, which can see connection metadata (your IP address, timing and size of requests), but not message contents. Use a proxy or your own server to change that.
Domain names are resolved by the proxy, not on this device. Tor\'s local port is usually 127.0.0.1:9050.
No valid answer from the server.
The app locks only when it starts and with Lock now. Turn the app lock on to lock it after inactivity or in the background.
Locking erases the decrypted data from memory and stops receiving. The password is required again.
Only while the app is unlocked. The lock screen still shows only “New message”.

Unless sender and text are switched on, notifications say only that a message arrived. While the app is locked, nothing is fetched and no notifications appear; messages wait on the server until you unlock.
The exported file is the encrypted vault with all chats and keys. Keep it safe; anyone with the file can try to guess the password.
The vault file on this device is deleted. Without an exported copy the account and all chats are lost. The name stays registered on the server.
Aegis is an experimental end-to-end encrypted messenger. The protocol and the source code are public.
No forward secrecy: if a long-term key leaks, past captured messages can be read.
The server and any network operator in between (such as Cloudflare) can see your IP address and when you send and fetch messages, and roughly how large they are.
Usernames are public in the server directory.
Groups share one key; a member who leaves can still read and write until the group is recreated.
Disappearing messages depend on the other side honouring them.
Messages are text only. There are no calls, files or images.
The app has no analytics, advertising or crash reporting, and talks only to the server you configure.
Keys stay only on this phone.
Everyone has a right to a private space.
No phone number, no email, no real name. A username and a password are enough.
The password cannot be recovered. The server never receives it.
Geist font — SIL Open Font License 1.1
Messages and attachments are removed from this device. Groups and channels are left.
Only you can post. Subscribers read and can mute the channel.
Your name and about line are sent to your contacts.
Stops screenshots and screen recording in every window and dialog and hides the app in the task switcher. With the app lock on the task switcher never shows a chat.
About every 15 minutes or more. The notification only says that something new arrived.
This contact needs to update the app.
Some messages could not be decrypted.
The key of this server is not the one saved on first use. Someone may be intercepting the connection. Do not continue unless the server owner confirmed the change.
A PIN reopens a locked session on this device. It also needs a secret held by the server, which erases it after 5 wrong tries; then only the password works. Unlocking with a PIN needs a connection.
Enter the PIN to remove it.
The PIN was erased after too many wrong tries. Use your password.

Entering this PIN deletes the account, its PIN files and its media from this device and shows the usual wrong-PIN message. Exported copies and messages held by other people stay. It is kept only on this device and never sent to the server.
While the app is open, it sends a dummy request now and then so that real ones cannot be told apart. High uses more data and battery.
Only do this if you know the server was reinstalled. Otherwise someone may be intercepting your connection.
Yes, I know the server was reinstalled
The duress PIN must differ from the real PIN.
These messages come from a key that is not in your contacts. Enter the username of the sender; it is accepted only if the directory lists that name with this key.
The directory does not list this name with that key.
They stay able to read what was sent before. New messages use fresh keys they will not receive.
You were removed from a group.
